name: The Sunken Path
library: 2       # Citadel Island tile set
template: 2      # borrow lighting and ambience from scene 2
# The lake is full of identical stepping stones. Most of them sink the
# moment you step on one. Stand on the sigil (@) on the south shore: the
# safe stones light up gold, but only while you stay on it. Memorise the
# path, cross, and claim the chest (action key in front of it) and the
# swirl that leads out.
reveal camera: 12 12   # frame the whole stone field from the sigil
raise: d               # land sits one cell up on a dirt bank; the lake is below
legend:
  d  floor 18              # dirt bank under the raised land
  g  floor 50              # grass
  .  floor 22              # stone paving
  ~  floor 99 low          # deep water (drowns)
  o  floor 81 over ~ hint 188   # safe boulder: gold plank while revealed
  x  floor 81 over ~ trap ~     # false boulder: vanishes under you
  @  floor 243 reveal      # the sigil
  E  floor 238 exit courtyard   # swirl: leave to the courtyard
  G  floor 22 give money 10
  $  object 178 on .       # chest
  L  object 117 on .       # lamp
  T  object 112 on g       # pine tree
  R  object 75 on g        # rocks (front edges, so they don't hide the shore)
  S  start on .
map:
  TgTgTgTgTgTgTgTgTgTgTgRg
  gggggggggggggggggggggggg
  TgggggggggggEE..$.ggggRg
  ggggggggggggEE....gggggg
